raw_segments.text: Edmund, come hither, Captain Hark. Take thou this note giving a paper. Go follow them to
prison. One step I have advanced thee. If thou dost as this instructs thee, thou dost
make thy way to noble fortunes. Know thou this, that men are as the time is. To be tender-minded
does not become a sword. Thy great employment will not bear question. Either say thou dot
